'''Sugar''' is a base [[ingredient]] in most preserves and sweet meals. Besides the vanilla recipe from sugar cane, it can be crafted from [[Honey|honey bottles]] or [[molasses]].

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
A honey bottle makes 3 sugar, and so does a molasses.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/sugar_from_molasses.json}}</ref> The vanilla honey recipe is replaced.

== Usage ==

Sugar goes into every jam, can and mead, the empanadas, cupcakes, toasts, cookies, [[cake]], [[cheese]], [[Chorus Mochi|chorus mochi]], [[Ice Cream|ice cream]] and the curry [[stock]]s.
